name: 🌷Fishing Simulator! 🐟
desc:
🐟 The ORIGINAL Roblox fishing simulator! Cast, catch, and collect 1000+ fish species with friends!

🐋 Hunt giant whales, massive sharks, and sea monsters
⛵ Sail the seas across 10+ unique islands
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Fish with friends and grow from noob to legend
🎣 Upgrade your rod and catch rarer fish

🛟 HOW TO PLAY
- Click into the air to cast your line
- Wait for a bite, and click as soon as you see it!
- Keep clicking to keep the line in the green zone
- When the progress bar is full, you'll catch the fish!

💎 Join our group for 250 bonus gems!
